title: BIS seizes ₹10 crore worth of 7.875 kg non-hallmarked gold jewellery in Telangana’s Warangal raid
description: BIS Hyderabad Branch Office Director advises consumers to purchase only BIS-hallmarked gold jewellery carrying a valid HUID, verify the HUID through the BIS CARE mobile application before purchase and insist on obtaining a proper invoice
